overall_summary: The channel's performance clearly highlights 'self respect' as the dominant winning content topic compared to generalized sadness or overthinking, pulling significantly higher view counts (averaging 30+ views vs single digits for late-night overthinking hooks).

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing on deleting chats, hiding status, or removing pinned names (e.g., rwOUYo_hayQ with 41 views, AfaLxMy6FMY with 40 views) consistently outperform passive sad thoughts.
winning_patterns.action: Focus future scripts on concrete digital boundaries (blocking, unpinning, clearing histories) rather than abstract sadness.

weak_patterns.evidence: Hooks like 'रात के दो बजे' (G0gKV1p3ZHc) or 'मेज पर रखी चाय ठंडी हो गई' (uIbMpCjVutQ) scored very low views (5 to 12 views).
weak_patterns.action: Reduce passive poetic tropes about time and tea; ground the pain in modern smartphone micro-interactions.
